notes: Added a character checklist with clear character tabs, daily and weekly activities, detailed Arena, Battlefield, Daeva Pass and Command counters, and separate shop and Substance Morph limits. Added a pet farming map with per-character collection progress and a player-position marker. Fixed character-switch ownership, stale completion status after resets and partial Command totals. Improved VLAN packet capture, reused NPC identity handling and nickname resizing. The installer now checks for Npcap and links to the official download when it is missing.
